prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity visual presentation board for an ORIGINAL mobile digital wedding invitation concept, not a real functioning website. Landscape 3:2 composition. Neutral pale stone background. Two tall flat mobile webpage viewport mockups side by side at matching scale, occupying most of the canvas, crisp straight-on view, minimal thin borders, NO bulky physical phone bodies, NO perspective, NO desktop screen. Left shows the wedding invitation landing viewport; right shows a carefully designed continuation viewport of the SAME website. Make both readable and convincingly implementable as responsive HTML. Place small refined board title above: "01 / MAGNOLIA EDITORIAL", and small labels "PORTADA" and "AL DESLIZAR" above corresponding screens. Below screens three small color swatches, no technical notes. Design direction: Quiet sophisticated editorial botanical luxury. Ivory cotton-paper background #F6F1E7, charcoal #292D29, restrained antique gold #A58B57. Left hero uses generous asymmetric whitespace, one oversized beautifully hand-drawn magnolia flower entering only from the upper right, restrained tiny monogram A&M top left, large high contrast fashion serif names left aligned, beautifully typeset ampersand, fine thin rules. Lower hero has a small horizontal editorial black and white photograph of a fictional happy Latin American couple. NO floral border. Right continuation uses a large editorial number 01, headline 'El gran día', a precise understated ceremony and celebration schedule, one small architectural line drawing of a hacienda, and RSVP action. Paper grain should be extremely subtle, text easy to read. Feels like luxury printed stationery translated thoughtfully to digital. Shared fictional event copy: "Ana & Mateo", "18 JUNIO 2027", "Bogotá, Colombia"; primary action "Confirmar asistencia"; small secondary link "Ver detalles". Every visible UI word in Spanish. Couple are fictional adults around thirty. Use professional high-end editorial wedding art direction, contemporary carefully balanced typography, intentional spacing, real-feeling photographic and illustrated assets. This must be a distinct authored design, not a generic SaaS website and not a copy of Fixdate. NO Fixdate brand, NO original-reference quotations, NO fake awards, NO marketing pricing, NO neon, NO irrelevant interface widgets, NO UI screen full of giant floating cards. Only include a modest amount of content so typography remains legible. The left screen should clearly communicate a wedding invitation at first glance. Render final polished conceptual board with consistent geometry and generous outer margin.
